overview.about: Rob Zombie and Marilyn Manson co-headline the Freaks on Parade tour, a theatrical, industrial-metal spectacle pairing two of shock rock's biggest names. Combining Zombie's horror-movie visuals with Manson's provocative stagecraft, it is one of the loudest and most visually extreme tours on the road.
